pose:
Create a production-ready TRANSPARENT PNG pixel-art sprite atlas for the six exact game characters in the first reference sheet, in its reading order (top row left to right, then bottom row left to right). The other four references specify the CRISP PIXEL ART treatment and canonical identities; do not copy the first reference's soft shading. Actual alpha transparency outside sprites, not an illustration of a checkerboard. Square 1536x1536 canvas, EXACTLY SIX EQUAL COLUMNS AND THREE EQUAL ROWS, eighteen separate full-body figures; each cell 256x512, no borders or labels. Do not crop heads or shoes. Generous transparent gutters. All six characters are adults, gender-neutral or feminine. Preserve each reference's exact skin tone, face, age, hairstyle, glasses, clothing colors and footwear. Columns left to right: 1 black bob/teal hairclip/round glasses/teal vest journalist; 2 dark skin/loc bun/burgundy headband/olive jacket organizer; 3 brown skin/short blue-black side shave/navy hoodie whistleblower; 4 older brown-skinned silver bob/glasses/plum pantsuit lobbyist; 5 brown curly bun/teal cardigan staffer; 6 brown skin/long black braid/red beanie/round glasses/olive jacket/mustard top satirist.
Row 1: each person sitting on a plain low backless wooden stool, tired and unwell, shoulders slightly hunched, eyelids heavy, hands resting on knees. Entire legs and feet visible, no treatment or cup. They are awake.
Row 2: SAME identities each sitting on the SAME stool, critically unwell and more slumped, head down, one hand at forehead, visibly weaker, still awake; no graphic injury, no death.
Row 3: SAME identities seated upright on same stool, recovering after care, relieved gentle expression, holding one plain cup of water at waist; full body.
All figures face three-quarter toward screen right, same scale and baseline per row. Established crisp chunky pixel art: hard stepped pixel clusters and clean dark outlines, limited flat palette, deliberate small highlights, no painterly realism, no gradients or blurred edges. No printed text or symbols on clothing/cups. Absolutely no crosses, religious symbols, devotional objects, flags, logos, insignia or region-identifying emblems. No scenery, floor, background color, shadow halo, lettering, title, UI or watermark. Preserve true transparent alpha. Only the eighteen figures and stools.
poseAlpha: Remove the checkerboard background from this image and return the same sprite sheet as a transparent PNG with actual alpha transparency. Preserve every character, stool, color, pose, pixel edge, cell position, and canvas dimension exactly. Do not redraw or rearrange anything. No replacement background or glow.

settings.A:
Production game background atlas in the established crisp chunky pixel-art style of the reference. PORTRAIT 1536x2048, EXACTLY 2 EQUAL COLUMNS by 4 EQUAL ROWS, eight borderless landscape panels each 768x512, in reading order. Each panel is a separate scene described below, not a collage within the panel. Match a deliberate low-resolution game palette, bold dark pixel contours, stepped pixel clusters, simple hard-edged shading. Do not use photorealism, smooth digital painting, blurred lighting, fine texture noise or simulated photographic depth. Use the reference for STYLE ONLY, not its characters or map composition.
These are background layers for a care scene. The affected current traveler will be composited later: DO NOT DRAW the affected traveler or any crew, DO NOT draw a chair/stool for them. In every panel reserve a clear, empty foreground area centered at x=23% of panel width, y=75%, approximately 28% wide and 65% tall, where the game will place one seated full-body person. Keep focal props and supporting NPCs in the right 60%. Show supporting NPCs only as specified, all feminine or gender-neutral adults of varied skin tones. Faces and hands distinct and readable. Props should sit naturally in the environment. View at seated-person eye height, no overhead views. Leave lower 12% reasonably quiet for the game's caption.
Opaque backgrounds. NO baked-in writing, readable text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, captions, UI, panel labels, watermarks. All signs, forms and book covers blank; text is rendered separately by the game. ABSOLUTELY NO religious symbols, crosses, medical crosses, devotional objects, religious clothing, flags, heraldry, sacred architecture or emblems. Secular ordinary interiors and roadside spaces. Neutral daylight illumination outdoors; warm readable indoor lighting; game applies current time/weather.

PANELS in reading order:
1: Roadside raw-milk stall. On the right, a feminine brown-skinned adult vendor with short dark hair and a plain apron proudly holds one unlettered white glass milk bottle. On the rear left is a closed plain portable toilet with no icon. A small exaggerated knife-shaped bottle shadow on the counter is the gag; no weapon or violence. Blank stall sign at upper right.
2: Loading yard in hot sun, crates stacked at right. A feminine older Black supervisor under a small shade umbrella holds a thick black marker next to a blank warning board. Visible heat shimmer above distant asphalt. Crates leave the lower-left seating space empty.
3: Simple diner booth and table, late-shift atmosphere but neutral readable light. At right a small mountain of blank forms and one crumpled work glove on the table. Empty foreground left floor/seating space; do not draw a diner patron.
4: Roadside tasting stall, a feminine East Asian vendor on right gestures proudly at a comically oversized unbranded drink cup wider than their torso. Cup has no straw in anyone's mouth, no drinking. Leave left floor space open. Blank stall sign.
5: Rest-area planning table on right with two identical unlettered maps whose route lines match, plus separate piles of blank removable label rectangles. Open ground left for a seated person. Plain trees and carpark in background; no named geography.
6: Rest-stop worktable on right with an open laptop showing a simple unlettered loading ring, a router and a blank upright broadband information card. Blank screen apart from loading ring, no numbers. Open floor left for a seated person.
7: Community worktable on right with an open plain laptop and exactly five distinct work objects in a line: keys, work gloves, paintbrush, folded map, portable radio. No text on any object. Open left floor for a seated person, no other worker needed.
8: Loading side of an affluent political fundraiser. On right, heavy crates of identical plain unlettered memoir books. A feminine silver-haired rich guest in an expensive cream suit carefully steps past the crates toward a plain podium. Plain parked blue van edge at rear, empty windows. Open left floor for affected traveler. No banners with symbols.

Preserve all eight panels, every composition, pixel style, character and prop, and the exact canvas/grid dimensions. In panel 5 (third row, left), make the two maps EXACT duplicates: same land shape, SAME red winding route, same thin secondary roads and same positions; the gag is that only their removable name labels differ, not geography, and all those labels must stay completely blank. In panel 1 (top left), add a small sharp knife-shaped SHADOW on the counter cast by the white milk bottle held by the vendor; there must be no actual knife, violence or injury. No other changes. All surfaces remain unlettered. Absolutely no religious symbols, crosses, logos, flags, text or watermarks.
